desc: Derive and verify the counting formula: `m * C(n - 1, k) * (m - 1)^(n - 1 - k)`.
Check edge cases, especially `m = 1`, `k = 0`, and `k = n - 1`.
Implement factorials and inverse factorials up to `n - 1` modulo `10^9 + 7`.
Implement modular exponentiation via Python’s built-in `pow(base, exp, MOD)`.
Write and validate the required `Solution.countGoodArrays` method in the supplied class format.
